decision_rationale: The paper presents a multimodal LLM trained on 5.5M instruction-following examples across 70+ task types, including free-text biological QA and open-ended reasoning. This is broad, transferable pretraining rather than a narrow application wrapper.
evidence_snippet: "We introduce OmicsLM, a multimodal LLM"; "train OmicsLM on more than 5.5 million instruction-following examples spanning over 70 task types"; "open-ended biological question answering"; "language-guided, multi-sample reasoning"; "free-text biological knowledge"; "natural-language biological tasks"; "perform comparably to specialized omics models"; "outperforming ... general LLMs"; "continuous vector ... projecting it into the LLM token-embedding space"; "multiple profiles can be interleaved in one prompt"; "can use expression profiles directly and perform comparably to specialized omics models"; "language-guided biological reasoning over expression data"
